reviews.title: I was told this is the next best thing to the banned Kaspersky Total Security.
reviews.comment: One presidential administration banned the use of Kaspersky on federal computers but allowed civilians to use it on their personal computers and devices.  The last presidential administration banned it from being used by civilians.  As a result, the Kaspersky Total Security suit that I purchased in March 2024 no longer can update itself.  Kaspersky handed it's US business to another anti virus company and allowed that company to install it's software onto people's computers.  Not cool.  Thanks to the government, I lost money on my 2 year subscription. After being a Kaspersky user for over 13 years, I was forced to find something else.  I previously had used  Mcafee or Norton before they became intrusive, annoying, weak at scanning for viruses and malware, and resource hogs.  Not to mention the customer service sucks for both products.  Look them up on user review sites like Trustpilot, if you do not believe me. So I have settled on what some people online suggest to be the next best alternative to Kaspersky.  Bitdefender is now installed on my PCs as well as my mom's PCs.  I purchased the 5 device 2 year Total Security suit.  Unlike Kaspersky, it does not come with a disk.  It comes as an envelope with a credit card size paper card with product key.  Once I setup up an account and entered product key, It downloaded the installation file and I had it installed on my computer within a few minutes.  It asked if I wanted to protect other devices.  Through my account, I was able email an invite with the download link to my mom.  She clicked the link and downloaded the installation file and had Bitdefender installed on one of her business PCs within a few minutes.  I did not have to share the product key or account password with her.  That in its self is a nice feature. So far, it seems to be working with out excessive annoying pop ups like you would get with Mcafee and Norton.  I liked how Kapersky would give you a real time on screen scan process indicator when inserting a flash drive.  Bitdefender seems to do it in the background.  Our computers have SSD storage and sufficient memory, so no slow down of computer resources has been noticed.
reviews.author: Aruss

reviews.title: GREAT BUY! Great for Gaming PC's!
reviews.comment: Been using Bitdefender Total Security for over a year and i love it. Easy to install and setup. Great for PC Gaming Setups. Block's incoming threats when your surfing the net & has a lot of security features. I love it when it notifies me if i have any windows 10 or any kind of update for my computer. One of the best parts of the software is "Activate profiles automatically" area. Automatically activates the right profile based on your current activity and running applications. So if your playing Video Games on your PC and if you set the "Game Profile" Configure and at the bottom check box "Real-time optimization" it will improve performance in real-time and eliminates interruptions while "Gaming Profile" is turn on. You can even Turn on Activate profiles "Automatically" so you don't have to keep clicking on what Profile to use if your watching a movie, using your e-mail, Battery mode profile or Public WiFi (Wi-Fi).  Bitdefender Total Security Support Center is great to use if you have any info that you would like ask. You can E-mail them or Call if you have any problems. You cant bet this price. I use to have Norton Security for the longest time and had a little trouble using it and all ways had virus still come in when i surf the net & it will slow down my PC when i came. Bitdefender is my number one Total Security and hope it keep getting better. FOR GAMER!!! MUST READ! The Utilities area is great. Has a One click "Optimizer" for remove unnecessary files one easy step. "Disk Cleanup" to clean your device from large files that take up a lot of space on your device. "Startup Optimizer" to boot faster by removing or delaying the start of your installed applications and a Anti-Theft protect what you store on your device in case of loss or theft. Bitdefender has some great Privacy Features like password manager, Data Protection,File Encryption, Safepay, Video & Audio Protection, Parental Advisor and Anti-Tracker and VPN that i here every one is using but you have to pay a little more but it is worth the money.
reviews.author: Matthew M.
